$comment: Screens and states the axe check (tests/a11y) visits in every viewport and colour scheme. {building} etc. are replaced by the ids of records the check seeds itself. Every new or changed screen is added here; every state name must be one of stateMeanings.

stateMeanings.default: The page as loaded with the seeded records (always checked).
stateMeanings.empty: A list or page with no records at all (checked against a fresh, empty database before seeding).
stateMeanings.filtered-empty: A list whose filter or search matches nothing.
stateMeanings.submit-empty: A form submitted without input: all validation errors visible.
stateMeanings.end-dialog: The dialog that ends a rental contract open.
stateMeanings.send-dialog: The confirmation before sending a statement open.
stateMeanings.reminder-dialog: The Mahnung dialog of a statement open.
stateMeanings.mark-paid-dialog: The dialog that marks a statement as paid open.
stateMeanings.every-wizard-step: Each step of the wizard in turn, including its result step.
stateMeanings.preview-empty: Statement wizard preview for a period without rental contracts.
stateMeanings.overlap-warning: Rental contract wizard with a start date that overlaps another contract of the apartment.
stateMeanings.ai-unavailable: Invoice form while the categorisation service is not reachable (always the case in the test stack).
stateMeanings.profile-sum-invalid: Heating profile form whose monthly shares do not add up to 100 %.
stateMeanings.formula-tested: Distribution key form after testing a formula.
stateMeanings.login-error: Login page showing a sign-in error (?error=…).
stateMeanings.first-use: Dashboard with no buildings yet: the getting-started guidance.
stateMeanings.mobile-menu-open: Mobile navigation drawer open (mobile viewport only).
stateMeanings.user-menu-open: User menu in the header open.
